summary: First-finish smoke test of TaticaFlow backend + frontend. All critical backend endpoints (auth/clubs/players/matches/upload/files/cascade) and full frontend flow (register -> dashboard -> clubs -> 11 players -> match -> editor -> formation 4-4-2 -> goal event increments score -> export PNG) pass end-to-end.
passed: POST /api/auth/register returns token and creates user (200)
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user
POST /api/upload accepts image and returns {path,url}; GET /api/files/{path} returns 200 bytes
Players CRUD + filter by club_id works (returns 1 for filtered club)
Matches CRUD: create sets defaults (0-0 scheduled), PUT partial update accepts {home_score, status}
Frontend /auth register auto-logs in and redirects to /
/jogadores: creates player with native <select> for position/club
/partidas: creates match with 2 different clubs; link opens editor
MatchEditor: formation-4-4-2 places 11 players on pitch automatically
MatchEditor: adding GOL event (min 10, TMA, Jogador 1) updates score to 1-0 in real time and shows in timeline
MatchEditor: export-image-btn triggers download of partida-TMA-TMB.png and button returns to 'GERAR IMAGEM'

failed.issue: html-to-image emits SecurityError when reading cross-origin Google Fonts CSS rules during PNG generation. Download still succeeds, but console shows errors.
failed.evidence: Console: 'Error while reading CSS rules from https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter... SecurityError: Failed to read the cssRules property from CSSStyleSheet'. Download event fired with partida-TMA-TMB.png.

failed.issue: React hydration warning: <span> injected inside <option> by dev instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic attribute). Does not affect functionality.
failed.evidence: Console: 'In HTML, %s cannot be a child of %s ... <span> option'

action_items: Optional: embed Inter font locally or preload as data URL to avoid html-to-image CORS warning during export (not blocking).
Optional: suppress ve dev-tool span injection inside <option> to eliminate hydration warning.
